waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: ready-when-started
mutations.why: A task becomes ready once its predecessors have started rather than finished (the ReadyWhenDone guard hard-wired to the buggy side).
mutations.search: Preds(t) \subseteq (IF ReadyWhenDone THEN done ELSE done \cup running)

mutations.name: redispatch-done
mutations.why: Dispatch no longer skips tasks that already finished, so a finished task can run again.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Dispatch and Finish the scheduler may stop with tasks left, so AllComplete must fail by stuttering.
mutations.search: Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(\E t \in Nodes : Dispatch(t) \/ Finish(t))
